title: Dragon Portal Cliff
description: A dramatic fantasy scene on a stormy cliff edge features a large black dragon emerging from a swirling purple portal, a woman in an orange dress reaching toward it, and a green octopus-like creature near a glowing tower. To the right, a woman with curly hair rides a red wagon labeled 'HAPPY FLYER' pulled by a green cat-like creature, with a pineapple, a scared spherical character, and lightning striking in the dark cloudy sky.
